# onepassword_vaults (Data Source)

Lists all 1Password vaults accessible to the configured credentials.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `vaults` (Attributes List) List of accessible vaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults))

<a id="nestedatt--vaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults`

Read-Only:

- `active_item_count` (Number) Number of active items.
- `attribute_version` (Number) Vault attribute version.
- `content_version` (Number) Vault content version.
- `description` (String) Vault description.
- `id` (String) Vault ID.
- `title` (String) Vault title.
- `vault_type` (String) Vault type, e.g. `personal`.
